Nucleus implantation.method_description: Freshwater pearl culture with surgical nucleus implantation for round and semi-round pearls.

stages.name: Collection & conditioning
stages.desc: Collect healthy wild or farmed mussels (Lamellidens marginalis / corrianus); condition for 2–4 weeks in nursery tanks.
tasks: Inspect for parasites and shell integrity
Set up conditioning tanks with green water algae

stages.name: Nucleus implantation & surgery
stages.desc: Surgical implantation of mantle graft tissue and shell beads by certified technician.
tasks: Prepare sterile surgery bench and menthol anaesthetic
Insert shell bead (2–6 mm) and mantle tissue into gonad
Record surgery count and bead dimensions

stages.name: Post-implantation recovery
stages.desc: Convalescence in shallow recovery cages; monitor bead rejection and surgical wound healing.
tasks: Daily mortality and bead rejection inspection
Maintain optimal DO (>6 mg/L) in recovery tank
Remove mortalities promptly to avoid infection
Record survival rate at day 7, 14, and 30

stages.name: Grow-out culture
stages.desc: Transfer to main farm pond in suspended PVC/mesh cages at 0.5–1.5 m depth; regular plankton feeding.
tasks: Monthly water quality testing (temp, pH, DO, turbidity)
Bi-monthly cage bio-fouling removal and scrubbing
Sample 10 mussels every quarter for mantle health
Maintain phytoplankton blooms via organic manuring

stages.name: Pre-harvest monitoring
stages.desc: Monitor nacre thickness (target >0.4 mm); plan commercial harvesting logistics.
tasks: Sacrifice 5 mussels to inspect nacre deposition thickness
Contact regional buyers, jewellers, and pearl mandis
Prepare pearl washing and cleaning equipment

stages.name: Harvest & processing
stages.desc: Open mussels carefully; extract pearls, clean with salt/detergent, buff, and sort by grade.
tasks: Sort by Grade A, B, and C
Record total yield and calculate net profit

Without implantation.method_description: Natural mantle cavitation / non-nucleated freshwater culture for baroque keshi pearls.

stages.name: Mussel stocking & conditioning
stages.desc: Stock juvenile/subadult mussels in net cages at 2–3 per m².

stages.name: Growth monitoring
stages.desc: Maintain plankton culture and monitor continuous mantle nacre secretion.

stages.name: Harvest preparation
stages.desc: Evaluate mussel maturity, size, and market buyer connections.
tasks: Examine sample mussels for pearl yield

stages.name: Harvest & grading
stages.desc: Harvest pearls, clean, polish, and classify baroque pearls.
tasks: Sell to domestic craft and jewellery makers

Long-line culture.method_description: Open-sea or sheltered bay marine long-line culture in rafts/droppers.

stages.name: Spat collection & hatchery rearing
stages.desc: Collect wild spat on artificial collectors or source from CMFRI oyster hatcheries.
tasks: Deploy spat collectors during post-monsoon settlement
Transfer spat to mesh nursery cages

stages.name: Nursery rearing
stages.desc: Grow spat up to 2.5–3.5 cm in sheltered bays with high microalgal food supply.

stages.name: Nucleus implantation surgery
stages.desc: Skilled implantation of spherical nucleus and mantle graft by experienced technician.
tasks: Graft mantle piece and nucleus into gonad

stages.name: Grow-out on long-lines
stages.desc: Suspend in 10-pocket net droppers from long-line rafts at 5–10 m ocean depth.
tasks: Monthly cage cleaning and fouling removal

stages.name: Pre-harvest assessment
stages.desc: Sample oysters to evaluate Akoya nacre thickness, orient, and roundness.
tasks: Examine 10 oysters for nacre layer thickness
Evaluate color, orient, and surface cleanliness

stages.name: Harvest & grading
stages.desc: Harvest, excise pearls, polish with beeswax/salt, and classify AAA, AA, A, B grades.
tasks: Record revenue and complete export documentation
